# Pixel 8 physical page-card captures

These files are redacted physical observations from the connected Pixel 8 running Cyclone
3.8.0-beta on 1 September 2026. They are evidence only and are intentionally outside the
synthetic `golden/*.json` contract corpus.

Only two safe pages were captured. The installed MCP surface did not expose `phone_locate`, and
both labelled targets were present in `pageText` and raw accessibility search but absent from the
semantic controls. The remaining ten pages stay unverified. Observation-scoped element IDs must
never be reused for execution.
